The Department of Statistics and Applied Probability is dedicated to advancing the field of statistics and applied probability through comprehensive efforts. Our mission is to coordinate and consolidate statistics education across the UCSB campus, working collaboratively with other departments to enhance pedagogical consistency. We are committed to extending and improving our graduate program to attract and train the next generation of leading researchers and professionals. We also strive to formalize and broaden the reach of our Statistical Consulting Laboratory, providing expert support to the wider university community. Finally, we actively encourage research activities by hosting a dynamic colloquium series and visitors program, fostering a vibrant environment of intellectual exchange and innovation.
